name: Genuine Video Visual & Pedagogical Quality Audit
registered_methods: Verify exact frozen artifact hashes and genuine model provenance; fail closed on synthetic, missing or tampered data.
Inspect all four narration beats by their real timestamps and deterministic host Manim action schedule; distinguish beat-level temporal matching from ASR/word-level alignment.
Decode actual H264 frames at fixed fps=2 downscaled 320x180; report foreground occupancy threshold luminance>30 and adjacent-frame mean absolute difference; descriptive metrics not population norms.
Report audio codec and nonzero physical signal, distinct from expert-rated TTS intelligibility, prosody, word alignment.
Compute arithmetic visual whole equality from actual four-part vs two-part Rectangle widths/heights, with 5% relative area mismatch as predeclared conceptual illustration warning.

Score educational depiction by three explicit teachable events: one-half partition, two-quarter partition, visible numerator+denominator times-two transformation; distinguish narration-only arithmetic.
Emit exact timestamped issue inventory, source anchors, evidence tables, filmstrip; do not claim independent human-blind review or superiority.
acceptance: identical grounded video/scene/compiled-Manim/provenance SHA and actual frame/codec proof
at least 12 actual sampled image frames linked to beat times and reproducible real video quality metrics
time-stamped positive evidence and failure inventory with code/scene or decoded pixels as anchors
explicit mathematical depiction check and signal coverage gap
audio/SRT per-beat timings, signal metrics and no fabricated word timestamps
quality verdict technical-origin PASS but pedagogical/visual quality NOT CERTIFIED, with clear remediation priorities
new CI downloads immutable source artifact from prior GitHub run, uses no OpenRouter API key/POST and applies adversarial mutation tests
V3-42 frozen result and one-shot budget untouched; no main merge
forbidden: any new model POST or paid trial
modified V3-42 activated content or reruns
misrepresent simulated media as real provider output
fabricate audio transcription or claimed blind review
